messages:
opsbot: ALERT — increased tail latency observed for hosted inference (us-east-1). Affects ~6% of requests, primarily long-context (>8k) generations. Possible 503s for some customers. https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2712345678 :rotating_light:

michael: looking. seeing elevated p95->p99 on grpc-proxy -> runtime path. stack traces show repeated kernel timeouts on model-worker-3x. attaching quick sample:
```
ERROR runtime: kernel call timeout: model-worker-3x-72: kernel_select failed after 120s
trace: kv-cache flush triggered
```

anita: thanks — i'm pausing the new kernel rollout to us-east-1 and reverting to previous kernel build on a small subset (10%) to test rollback impact. will update in ~5m.

ryan: starting canary rollback now. command: `./deploy rollback --cluster us-east-1 --label kernel=v2.3.1 --percent 10`

kate: support: we've queued a customer broadcast draft for affected tenants (tier: hosted, large-context). ping me if wording looks ok.

support: please tag any tenants with >100k tokens/day usage; priority notify.

michael: rollback in progress. observed reduction in error rate on canary hosts within 90s. p99 dropped from 2.4s to 700ms on those nodes. continuing rollout to 50% while we monitor.

opsbot: INCIDENT PAGE: https://incidents.redwood.example/2712345678 (live updates + runbook)

anita: mitigation steps so far:
- paused kernel rollout (v2.4.0)
- rolled back 10% -> 50% with v2.3.1 canary
- increased KV-cache TTL to reduce eviction churn for long-context sessions
- raised autoscale headroom on us-east-1 runtime pool by 15%

ryan: monitoring graphs: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/runner/hosted-latency?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now (p95/p99 trending down)

kate: customer comms: short note sent to affected customers (list attached on incident page). advised retry with exponential backoff and optional model-size fallback.

michael: next steps: finish rollback to 100% if metrics stay stable for 10m, then run a controlled reintroduce of kernel v2.4.0 with added logging and a lower concurrency cap.

anita: assigning post-incident action item: regression test for kernel selection under long-context workloads + add automatic rollback trigger when kernel errors > 0.5% over 2m. I'll create ticket.

sara: can infra please capture flamegraphs from affected hosts before they recycle? might help root cause.

ryan: yes capturing now, archiving to /incidents/2712345678/artifacts.

michael: status update: p99 stable, error rate back to baseline. continuing to watch. will notify when we close. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: Broadcast to #customers-facing scheduled in 10m with incident summary and mitigation.

support: thanks all — keeping #support on watch for any customer replies.

michael: closing note: if anyone sees recurrence, please escalate with `@oncall` and add logs to the incident page.
